items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know just the type of music until St. Martin de Porres was canonized in '62 and I wrote this thing, St. Martin de Porres, dedicated to him.

ctx.x: You mentioned the fact that people were asking you to write a mass. Had you started working on that at this particular time?
